messages:
Ana (Product): Quick thread to define the 'sellable surface' for private deployments. We need crisp customer commitments so sales doesn't overpromise.

Ana (Product): Proposal: three lanes with customer-facing names: Sellable Surface (GA), Stability Lane (post-GA short cycle), Enterprise Lockdown (paid add-on). Each lane gets explicit acceptance criteria and a short "what we don't do" section.

Ravi (Eng): +1. Call out the exact networking promises in plain English. Customers often conflate VIP preservation with BGP/peering.

Tess (Field): Field asks: include a tiny "network pact" customers sign during install: netops contact, VIP (optional), LB type, and a smoke endpoint. That will reduce finger-pointing.

Ana (Product): Draft Sellable Surface bullets:
```
- Single-node operator, runs in customer k8s namespace
- Installer supports online (helm-ish) and offline tarball with signed manifest
- Default TLS: self-signed, option to supply certs
- No customer-managed LB required; we host the service type by default
- Documented minor-upgrade lane (no IP guarantee unless network pact supplied)
- Opt-in telemetry + log export steps
- Short runbook for rollback + simple healthchecks
```

Marco (Infra): For signed manifest we need a public key published. Ops can spin up signing this sprint. Also note: offline bundle expiry/resign policy needs coverage.

Ivy (PM): Draft Stability Lane bullets:
```
- Multi-node operator with leader election and basic HA
- Installer accepts a network-pact YAML: {vip, lb_type, cert_mode, netops_contact}
- Installer validates reachability of VIP and stores a hash to enforce contract during upgrades
- Upgrade verification test: smoke endpoint must respond post-patch upgrade
- Basic KMS integration (shim) for secrets; BYOK later
- Supported CNI list documented (preserve VIP only on tested CNIs)
```

Ravi (Eng): Implementation note: validator will compute sha256 of the pact and store it in our operator config. Upgrades compare hashes; if mismatch, operator fails with clear remediation message. We add an acceptance test that simulates contract unchanged vs changed.

Tess (Field): Please add a line in Stability Lane "if network-pact changes, maintenance window required" that sales can copy into SOWs.

Ana (Product): Enterprise Lockdown (brief):
```
- Everything in Stability Lane plus: BYOK/KMS integration, HSM option, audit log export to customer SIEM, retention controls, SOC artifacts
- Requires security review and commercial agreement
- SLA and dedicated support channel available as add-on
```

Marco (Infra): Constraints: preserving VIP across upgrades on some cloud provider CNIs is brittle. We'll publish a matrix: supported CNIs, known workarounds, and a downgrade path.

Ivy (PM): Prioritization: ship Sellable Surface as GA (goal: 5 weeks), kick off Stability Lane work in parallel focused on network-pact schema + VIP validator (goal: +3 weeks). Enterprise Lockdown gated by security review and sales commitments.

Ravi (Eng): Rough effort: Sellable Surface ~4-6w (1 eng + docs); network-pact + validator ~3w ( +1 eng); validator tests + smoke test infra ~1w.

Tess (Field): If we can promise network-pact VIP validation inside 8 weeks we can convert 2 pilots. I'll coordinate.

ci-bot: build: installer pipeline started (build-2026.05.12-0830).

Ana (Product): Decision: ship Sellable Surface GA with explicit exclusions (no VIP guarantee unless network-pact supplied). Start network-pact schema and VIP plumbing immediately. Hold Enterprise Lockdown for later. Owners: Ravi = GA lead, Tess = network-pact spec + field checklist, Marco = signing infra, Ivy = sales one-pager and docs.

Tess (Field): I'll draft network-pact YAML today and include a netops_contact and smoke_test_url. Will also prepare a short "non-goals" doc for sales.

Ravi (Eng): I'll open tickets: installer offline bundle signing, upgrade-lane doc, validator task. Need clarity on acceptance tests.

Marco (Infra): Ops tasks: generate signing keypair, publish public key URL, add bundle expiration check.

Ivy (PM): I'll draft a 1-page customer-facing FAQ: "What you get in GA", "How to request Stability Lane", and "What triggers an upgrade maintenance window".

Ana (Product): Thanks. We'll review progress at the Friday install sync. Keep communications simple for customers: explicit network pact = IP preservation; anything else requires Enterprise Lockdown. :thumbsup:
